title: Product showcase
summary: Show a product's features and details in a clean showcase video.
description: Turn product photos or video clips into a clear visual introduction. Highlight the details your audience cares about most, with a style and pace that fit your brand.
brief: Use {{product assets}} to make a showcase video for {{product}}, focusing on {{key features}}, mainly for {{audience}}.

fields.label: product assets
fields.hint: Attached product photos, real footage or descriptions

fields.label: product
fields.hint: What the product is; include its name if it has one

fields.label: key features
fields.hint: Two or three features or details most worth a close-up

fields.label: audience
fields.hint: Who will buy it, and what they care about most
